title: Adaptive latency histogram mart for tenant SLA attribution and compact quantile joins
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We need sub-minute tenant-level latency SLAs and cost-attribution slices across millions of invocations without storing full per-invocation distributions. Exact quantile queries are too expensive at scale.

Proposal: Build a curated mart that stores compact sketch aggregates (t-digest / HDR-like sketches) at the (tenant, route, 1m) granularity and a merged mart for daily/hourly rollups. Consumers (dashboards, alerts, billing joins) will compute approximate quantiles by merging sketches in-query. This enables fast SLA checks (p50/p95/p99), trend charts, and percentile-based cost buckets while keeping storage and scan costs bounded.

Key design points:
- Sketch type: t-digest for heavy-tailed latency distributions (good p99 fidelity) and small serialized footprint.
- Granularity: 1-minute canonical window with pre-aggregated hourly and daily rollups.
- Retention: sketches kept at minute resolution for 14 days, hourly for 90 days, daily for 2 years.
- Backfill: initial 30-day backfill using sampled exact-aggregation for verification.
- Storage: BigQuery table consoles_marts.adaptive_latency_hist with schema (tenant_id, route_id, window_start, window_size, tdigest_bytes, count, sum, min, max).
- Querying: provide SQL UDFs to merge/deserialize t-digests and extract quantiles. Provide a fallback path using sampled raw_invocations for tenants in canary.

Trade-offs considered:
- Accuracy vs size: t-digest gives good p95/p99 but degrades for extreme tails—mitigate via periodic exact-sample validation and adjustable compression parameter per-tenant.
- Freshness vs cost: 1-minute windows increase writes; to cap write QPS we run batched Spark streaming jobs with microbatch intervals and write to BigQuery append-only partitions.
- Complexity: introduces new UDFs and client libraries; we will publish wrappers and add dashboard tiles to surface approximation error bounds.
acceptance_criteria: tables created: consoles_marts.adaptive_latency_hist (minute/hour/day partitions) and consoles_marts.adaptive_latency_hist_meta
producer job (spark streaming) writing minute sketches in <5m end-to-end for small clusters
SQL UDFs available in BigQuery for merge_tdigest(tdigest_array) and tdigest_quantile(tdigest, q)
backfill completed for last 30 days and validation report showing <=2% error at p95 for 95% of tenants
Looker dashboard showing p50/p95/p99 trends and a per-tenant approximation error tile
Canary rollout to 10 low-volume tenants and feature-flagged fast-path in console alerts
